meta.what_this_is: Outcome of the most recent scheduled detection ATTEMPT, whether it succeeded or failed. The comparison feed records completed comparisons only; this file records attempts, so a broken schedule is visible instead of silently showing a stale result as current.

how_to_read_status.ok: the last attempt collected, compared and published successfully
how_to_read_status.baseline: the last attempt collected a first snapshot; nothing to compare yet
how_to_read_status.failed: the last attempt did not complete; the displayed result may be stale
how_to_read_status.unknown: no attempt has been recorded yet
